## Evidence

Paste the commands you ran:

```bash
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

For repair/eval changes, include:

```bash
npm run eval:viral
npm run eval:react
npm run test:packed
```

## Safety

- [ ] No API keys, screenshots with secrets, or `.buttonprobe` artifacts are committed.
- [ ] The current checkout remains clean after worktree verification.
- [ ] New repair claims have deterministic test or UI evidence.
- [ ] README/support-scope wording does not overclaim unsupported frameworks or workflows.
